info.title: outpost
info.description: The API of outpost: one domain per feature, under /api/<domain>/.

role.description: admin: also the control actions (modules, devices, deleting shared data) and the accounts

createdAt.description: unix seconds; null for the scripts' local access

setup.description: no account exists yet: the web app asks for the admin account (and the setup code)

user.description: the logged-in account, null when logged out

code.description: the one-time setup code: CORE_DATA_DIR/setup.code, printed by install.sh / start.sh

path.description: web route of the module (e.g. /maps/); also its passthrough under /svc

nav.description: nav group: apps on top, system screens (System, Logs, ...) at the bottom

enabled.description: switched on (persisted); modules not installed are never enabled

missing.description: requires[] entries that are still unset

state.description: 'missing' = no container, otherwise the container's state (running, exited, created, ...)

error.description: last start/stop failure, cleared on the next attempt

control.description: core can reach podman.socket and start/stop modules

inputVolts.description: Pi 5 PMIC EXT5V_V: the 5 V rail as delivered by the PSU

socWatts.description: Sum of the PMIC rails (Pi 5 only); excludes USB peripherals

psuMaxCurrentMa.description: Current the PSU negotiated via USB-PD (Pi 5 only)

usbHighCurrent.description: true = USB ports may draw 1.6 A, false = limited to 600 mA

underVoltageNow.description: live under-voltage alarm from the rpi_volt hwmon

app.description: compose project, i.e. the outpost app directory

cpuPercent.description: share of the whole machine, percent

self.description: the container core runs in (cannot be stopped from here)

counts.description: TCP sockets per state (ESTABLISHED, LISTEN, TIME_WAIT, ...)

state.description: checking = no answer yet; disabled = CORE_INTERNET_CHECK_URLS is empty

checkedAt.description: when the last check finished (ms since epoch)

latencyMs.description: round trip of the answering request, ms

minutes.description: one point per minute, last 24 h

ready.description: true once tiles can be downloaded and rendered

diskWarning.description: set when the archive would not comfortably fit on the disk

state.description: "paused": a download stopped on request; what it fetched is kept for a resume

stage.description: short label for the current step, e.g. "downloading tiles"

resumable.description:
download jobs only: what was fetched is kept, so the download can go on
from there (mapsResumeDownload) instead of starting over. Set on a
failed or paused download.

detail.description: context when disambiguating, e.g. "Germany" or the OSM type

name.description: override the region id used in URLs and filenames

build.description: planet build to extract from, YYYYMMDD; omit for the latest

force.description: replace an existing region of the same name

build.description: planet build date, YYYYMMDD: a resume always continues this build

downloadedBytes.description: bytes fetched so far, out of estimate.transferBytes

reason.description: why it stopped; "interrupted" = the maps module stopped while it ran

downloads.description: every unfinished download except the one running now

emoji.description: a single emoji, rendered as the map marker

installed.description: the helper has reported at least once (it is installed)

appliedAt.description: unix seconds of its last run

error.description: its last run failed (e.g. nft missing)

pending.description: the block list changed and the helper has not applied it (yet)

active.description: the hotspot runs now (the interface is in access-point mode)

helper.description: the host helper is installed (it has reported at least once)

pending.description: asked for, but the helper has not handled it (yet)

appliedAt.description: unix seconds of the helper's last run

iwAvailable.description: `iw` works (false: no Wi-Fi on this host, e.g. macOS)

interface.description: the hotspot interface (NETWORK_IFACE, or the first in AP mode)

mode.description: "ap" while the hotspot runs, "managed" while the Pi is a Wi-Fi client

vendorPrefixes.description: entries in the offline vendor database

leasesReadable.description: the DHCP leases folder is mounted (IP and hostname)

on.description: true: start the hotspot, false: stop it

inactiveMs.description: ms since the last frame from the device

hostname.description: the name the device sent with its DHCP request

vendor.description: manufacturer from the IEEE registry; null if unknown or randomized

randomized.description: a private (locally administered) address: phones use one per network

connected.description: associated with the hotspot right now

enforced.description: the block is in the firewall (the host helper applied it)

leaseExpires.description: unix seconds; null for no live lease

you.description: the browser that asked is this device (same IP)

note.description: why it is blocked, shown in the list

freeBytes.description: bytes free on its disk, null when unknown

maxUploadBytes.description: largest file one upload may be (FILES_MAX_UPLOAD_MB)

minFreeBytes.description: uploads that would leave less than this free are refused (FILES_MIN_FREE_MB)

path.description: relative to the shared folder, "/"-separated, e.g. "Photos/house.jpg"

mime.description: guessed from the name, null when unknown or a folder

url.description: the URL of a file's bytes, /api/files/raw/<path> (null for folders)

from.description: file or folder to move or rename

updatedAt.description: unix seconds of the newest change, null when empty

kind.description: notice: news for everyone; need: someone needs something; offer: someone can give or help; checkin: who is where and how

author.description: who wrote it, as typed (there are no accounts)

done.description: a need met, an offer taken: kept, shown last

waterLitresPerDay.description: water per person and day, for drinking and cooking

targetDays.description: how many days the stock should last

expiryWarningDays.description: items expiring within this many days are flagged

waterLitres.description: litres of water that have not expired

waterDays.description: how long the water lasts for everyone at the daily amount

updatedAt.description: unix seconds of the newest change, null when empty

unit.description: free text, e.g. "L", "kg", "pcs"; L, dl, cl and ml count as water

minimum.description: below this the item is low

location.description: where it is kept, e.g. "Cellar shelf 2"

daysLeft.description: days until it expires (negative: expired), null without a date

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD; empty or null for none

delta.description: added to the quantity (negative: used up); it never goes below 0

name.description: kiwix book name, part of its content URLs

language.description: ISO 639-3 code(s) of the first language, e.g. "eng"

size.description: bytes of the ZIM file, when known

fulltext.description: has a full-text index (searchable), otherwise titles only

viewerUrl.description: kiwix's viewer with its toolbar, e.g. /svc/library/viewer#wikipedia_en_all

language.description: the language searched (ISO 639-3, English when there is an English book), null when no book has a full-text index

starter.description: the emergency starter set and which of it is installed

viewerUrl.description: kiwix viewer URL for the article

book.description: title of the book it is in

hit.description: the top hit, null when nothing matches

state.description: running = downloading or checking now; unknown = no status yet (never synced, or not readable)

phase.description: while running: checking what's missing, fetching the Kiwix catalog, downloading a book

downloadedBytes.description: bytes on disk so far (approximate: from the partial file), null when unknown

index.description: position of the current book in the selection (1-based), 0 when none

failed.description: books that failed in this run

result.description: last finished run: ok, problems or interrupted

update.description: also download newer versions of installed books (old files stay until pruned)

key.description: Kiwix name: the ZIM file name without date suffix and ".zim"

size.description: bytes: the installed file's size, else the approximate download size; null when unknown

starter.description: keys of the emergency starter set (the books the emergency index needs)

freeBytes.description: bytes free in KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT_DIR, null when unknown

kind.description: core = core's own Nest logger (in memory); container = podman logs

containerError.description: why container logs can't be read (no podman socket), else null

ts.description: ms since epoch; null when the line carries no time

level.description: parsed from the line (Nest, JSON, Python logging); "log" when unknown

context.description: Nest context or logger name, e.g. "ModulesService"

stream.description: the container stream it came from (null for core's own buffer)

available.description: false when the logs can't be read; see error

slug.description:
URL path of the page: the file path without numeric prefixes, ".md" and
"README" ("02-installation/01-install.md" -> "installation/install",
"README.md" -> "")

title.description: the first "# " heading, else the file name

depth.description: 0 = docs/README.md, 1 = a chapter, 2 = a page of a chapter, ...

root.description: where the files are, for "read them without the app" hints

version.description: the app's version (root package.json), e.g. "0.1.0"; null if unknown

changelog.description: slug of the changelog page (docs/07-changelog.md), null if missing

prev.description: the pages before and after in reading order

trail.description: the chapters above this page, outermost first (no docs/README.md)

snippet.description: the first line that matches, as plain text

value.description: the value in effect; null when unset or secret (see `secret`)

isSet.description: true when the value is non-empty

secret.description: a PIN, password, token or URL with credentials: the value is never sent

defaultValue.description: the value in .env.example; null when the variable isn't documented there

description.description: the comment above it in .env.example, '' if none

changed.description: true when the value differs from .env.example's

id.description: the block's name in .env.example, e.g. "maps"; "other" for variables only in .env

title.description: the module's label when the block belongs to a module, else the id

module.description: module id when the block belongs to a module, else null

installed.description: false for an optional module not in MODULES

module.description: module id from its section, null for core-wide dirs

installed.description: false when its module is not installed

value.description: the value as written in .env (may be relative to the project folder)

hostPath.description: absolute path on the Pi; null when it can't be resolved

exists.description: the directory exists (false: drive not mounted, or never created)

device.description: block device of the filesystem it is on, e.g. /dev/sda1

mountPoint.description: where that filesystem is mounted, e.g. /media/Data

totalBytes.description: size of that filesystem in bytes

freeBytes.description: free space on it for unprivileged users, in bytes

project.description: the project folder (git checkout) on the Pi; null when unknown

source.description: where the values come from: the .env file itself or core's environment

envFile.description: path of the .env file on the Pi; null when it couldn't be read

version.description: the app's version (root package.json); null if unknown

bytes.description: bytes used on disk (like du); null when the directory can't be read

complete.description: false when the walk stopped at its time or file limit (bytes is then a lower bound)

id.description: stable id, e.g. module:maps or dir:MAPS_DATA_DIR

status.description: ok = fine, info = worth knowing, warn = will cause trouble, fail = broken now

details.description: the findings behind it (one per line), or null

fix.description: what to do about it, or null when nothing is needed

module.description: module id the check is about, or null

minutes.description: one point per minute, last 24 h

live.description: every sample of the last 15 minutes
